ant_audit.rank_interpretation: Monte Carlo comparison with the specified random-direction ensemble; exchangeability of the primary is an additional assumption for a calibrated null-hypothesis p-value.

audit_direction_algebra.limitation: The origin and finite-difference accuracy of saved g_yaw/g_omega require model execution; only their algebraic use is checked here.

execution_boundary: Saved arrays and NumPy/SciPy statistics only; no model loading, inference, gradients, training or simulator execution.

publication.display_precision: Coordinates and reward blocks are rounded to six decimals; raw effects retain full precision.
